nodes.summary: Let $(X_i)_{i \in I}$ be a family of topological spaces indexed by a preorder $I$, with maps $f_{ij} : X_i \to X_j$ for $i \le j$ forming a directed system. This is the smallest equivalence relation on the disjoint union $\bigsqcup_{i \in I} X_i$ that relates $(i, x)$ to $(j, f_{ij}(x))$ for all $i \le j$ and $x \in X_i$.
nodes.title: Direct limit equivalence relation

nodes.summary: Let $(X_i)_{i \in I}$ be a directed system of topological spaces over a preorder $I$ with continuous transition maps $f_{ij} : X_i \to X_j$, and let $Y$ be a topological space. If the maps $\psi_i : X_i \to Y$ are continuous and satisfy $\psi_j(f_{ij}(x)) = \psi_i(x)$ for all $i \le j$ and $x \in X_i$, then the induced map $\varinjlim X_i \to Y$ from the direct limit, sending the class of $(i, x)$ to $\psi_i(x)$,…
nodes.title: The induced map out of the direct limit is continuous

nodes.summary: Let $(X_i)_{i \in I}$ be a directed system of topological spaces over a preorder $I$ with continuous transition maps $f_{ij} : X_i \to X_j$, and let $Y$ be a topological space. A family of maps $\psi_i : X_i \to Y$ with $\psi_j(f_{ij}(x)) = \psi_i(x)$ for all $i \le j$ and $x \in X_i$ induces the map $\varinjlim X_i \to Y$ from the direct limit that sends the class of $(i, x)$ to $\psi_i(x)$.
nodes.title: Map out of the direct limit

nodes.summary: Let $(X_i)_{i \in I}$ be a directed system of topological spaces over a preorder $I$ with continuous transition maps $f_{ij} : X_i \to X_j$. The canonical maps $\iota_i : X_i \to \varinjlim X_i$ into the direct limit satisfy $\iota_j(f_{ij}(x)) = \iota_i(x)$ for all $i \le j$ and $x \in X_i$.
nodes.title: Canonical maps commute with the transition maps

nodes.summary: Let $(X_i)_{i \in I}$ be a directed system of topological spaces over a preorder $I$ with continuous transition maps $f_{ij} : X_i \to X_j$. For every $i \in I$, the canonical map $\iota_i : X_i \to \varinjlim X_i$ into the direct limit is continuous.
nodes.title: Canonical maps into the direct limit are continuous

nodes.summary: Let $(X_i)_{i \in I}$ be a directed system of topological spaces over a preorder $I$ with continuous transition maps $f_{ij} : X_i \to X_j$. For $i \in I$, the canonical map $\iota_i : X_i \to \varinjlim X_i$ into the direct limit sends $x$ to the class of $(i, x)$.
nodes.title: Canonical map into the direct limit

nodes.summary: Let $(X_i)_{i \in I}$ be a family of topological spaces indexed by a preorder $I$, with maps $f_{ij} : X_i \to X_j$ for $i \le j$ forming a directed system ($f_{ii}$ is the identity and $f_{jk} \circ f_{ij} = f_{ik}$ for $i \le j \le k$). This relation on the disjoint union $\bigsqcup_{i \in I} X_i$ relates $(i, x)$ to $(j, f_{ij}(x))$ for all $i \le j$ and $x \in X_i$, and relates no other pairs.
nodes.title: Generating relation of a direct limit

nodes.title: Direct limit of topological spaces

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
